title: Senior Engineer BOTTOM
description:
Lead the technical design and development of soft-real-time web-based applications and platforms.
Define application architecture, technology choices, coding standards, and development practices.
Design and develop scalable, secure, and maintainable frontend and backend systems.
Lead database design, data modeling, query optimization, and integration with application services.
Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to coding, security, performance, and architectural standards.
Identify technical risks, bottlenecks, and scalability issues and drive their resolution.
Guide developers through technical challenges and mentor junior and mid-level engineers.
Break down requirements into technical tasks and provide effort and implementation estimates.
Troubleshoot production issues and lead root-cause analysis for critical incidents.
Ensure applications follow appropriate security practices, including authentication, authorization, data protection, and secure API design.
Evaluate new technologies and frameworks and recommend their adoption when they provide meaningful technical or business benefits.
Maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, API documentation, and development guidelines.

Required Technical Skills:

Strong backend development experience using technologies such as Node.js
Strong experience in JavaScript and Hands-on expertise in React.js
Strong understanding of HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, and browser fundamentals.
Knowledge of application security, performance optimization, caching, logging, and monitoring.
Good understanding of software design principles, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and system design.
Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Technical Leadership:

Make sound technical decisions and communicate their rationale clearly.
Establish coding and architectural standards across the team.
Review and improve the technical quality of the codebase.
Identify opportunities to simplify systems and reduce technical debt.
Mentor developers and improve the team's technical capabilities.
Balance short-term delivery requirements with long-term maintainability.
Take ownership of technically complex features and critical production issues.
Ensure that technical decisions remain aligned with product and business requirements.
